content.text: {"quote_faithful":"yes","verdict":"confirmed","evidence_kind":"missing_justification","fatal":"yes","explanation":"The quoted sentence appears verbatim and explicitly says the Part A proof still “needs writing.” Although the write-up gives a substantial all-n outline, it does not actually supply the exchange argument needed for the matching identity, instead merely asserting that identity “by an exchange argument.” That identity is essential for choosing a matching whose cost equals D and hence for transferring the component lower bound to D. The later algebra and block lemma cannot repair this omitted link. The geometric specialization is immediate from a_1=δ and a_{i+1}=δ+sum_{j≤i}a_j, so its omission alone would be minor; likewise, the odd-cycle remark is not itself the justification for dropping cyclic components. Nevertheless, the missing proof of the load-bearing matching identity leaves the required all-n lower-bound argument incomplete as written."}
